supersedes: final-review-v1.json remains immutable historical evidence. Its unconnected command-fetch/packet-owner integration requirements are now resolved in the tested geometry_mesh_stream component; they are no longer outstanding component defects.
resolved_combined_owner_requirements: One physical AXI master switches to command prefetch after raw LOAD completion; no accepted raw read is abandoned.
Fallback visibility and task ACK wait for command prefetch to drain. Wrong serial cannot release the task.
Accepted packet launch automatically owns raw/list ports. External inspection cannot corrupt packet validation or emission.
Cancel wins against simultaneous first packet launch. Once launch is accepted ordinary cancel is ignored; held/repeated starts cannot duplicate publication.
Packet completion is required before success ACK. Packet prevalidation errors emit zero words and remain explicit repair outcomes.
Reset contract explicitly requires coupled AXI responder and packet consumer reset; standalone producer reset after partial publication is unsupported.
producer_review: The host producer enforces hardware count/index limits, immutable task/context keys, bounded credits, ordered completion and drain-before-generation recycle.
Host allocations and detached source bytes do not prove hardware DMA leases, RV32 submission cost or a running application path.
Sequence/handle exhaustion and actual PSRAM address/cache/publication binding remain integration obligations.
work_interpretation: The 244 geometry-accepted warm tasks contain 2,008 input triangles. Material-ready/nonzero memo is only a proxy for renderer eligibility. The 609,377 plus 256,297 focused cycles are 19.82% of the 4,366,717-cycle interval as charged CPU work, not a predicted frame-time saving. Raw service remains necessary and overlaps some older pending submission. PC retirement gaps include memory/FIFO waits; task interval does not prove logical packet ownership.
remaining_integration_requirements: Integrate coarse task publication into the real app before synchronous raw LOAD, canonical readback and per-triangle CPU admission; measure actual RV32 preparation and queue submission costs.
Capture immutable material, viewport and raster state in draw order. Preserve cold/deferred material behavior and alpha/LOD/texture side effects; current scene packets use controlled material flags.
Implement ordered task-local clipping/equal-W/arithmetic/material repair without restoring stale global renderer state. Packet error must take its zero-output repair path.

Bind the real PSRAM offset window, command/source cache maintenance, source/context leases and pool drain. Preserve raw slots required by partial-load or later CPU consumers; handle sequence/generation exhaustion.
Connect bounded descriptor/output queues and actual GPU ingress. Demonstrate paired full-frame correctness and net performance under real contention, fallback and output pressure.
Only a useful integrated gain justifies a fresh Quartus fit/timing run. Final ALM/M10K use and achievable clock remain unproven.
package_review: The five portable recipes are synthetic packet, fetch, engine, chain and stream-control tests; their tested RTL/C++ inputs are hash-checked before copying.
Scene, current-CPU oracle and producer evidence retain external source-bound receipts. Reproducer scripts require private captured inputs; they are not portable fixture-free tests.
Source package claims no app deployment, bitstream, new full-frame gain or physical fit. Final package construction and manifest verification are performed separately by the root agent.
